title: An Essay on the Inequality of the Human Races

chunks.text:
Originally published in French as _Essai sur l'inégalité des races humaines_ in 1853–1855. [Text and publication details](https://classiques.uqam.ca/classiques/gobineau/essai_inegalite_races/essai_inegalite_races.html).

The cover is Hachette BnF's facsimile of volume 1 of the 1884 edition. This reading entry covers the whole work. [Cover edition](https://www.hachettebnf.fr/livre/essai-sur-linegalite-des-races-humaines-vol-1-ed1884-9782012543218/).
